snippet.title: The Coast Is Clear Tidy up the Beach! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Collect, sort and save the turtles and the coral reef in this relaxing tidy up cleaning simulation. Earn money to get better cleaning tools and skills. Sort the stores, beach chairs, beach toys and restore the coral reef as you pick and sort all 6,136 items! 

Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5205300/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_content=video_description
